environment.description: AWS Lambda function deployed with Function URL configured with AuthType=NONE. The function URL endpoint is publicly accessible at https://abcdef1234.lambda-url.us-east-1.on.aws/. No additional authentication layer, no API Gateway, no CloudFront distribution in front. Lambda execution role has read access to EFS mount at /tmp/firmware containing device firmware and also sensitive configuration files in parent directories. The /tmp/firmware EFS mount is a shared filesystem also containing /tmp/secrets/ and /tmp/config/ directories with database credentials and API keys.
